<script id="premium-ui-enhancements">
(() => {
  const byId = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const modelInfo = byId('modelInfo');
  const modelStatus = byId('modelStatus');
  const syncStatus = () => {
    if (!modelInfo || !modelStatus) return;
    const txt = (modelInfo.textContent || '').trim();
    const loaded = txt && !/^No model loaded/i.test(txt);
    modelStatus.classList.toggle('loaded', !!loaded);
    const label = modelStatus.querySelector('.status-text');
    if (label) label.textContent = loaded ? 'Model ready' : 'Ready';
  };
  syncStatus();
  if (modelInfo) new MutationObserver(syncStatus).observe(modelInfo, {childList:true, subtree:true, characterData:true});

  const labels = {
    btnOpen: 'Open IFC model',
    btnOpen2: 'Open IFC model',
    btnSchemaView: 'Open validation schema',
    btnExport: 'Export validation outputs'
  };
  Object.entries(labels).forEach(([id, title]) => { const el = byId(id); if (el) el.setAttribute('aria-label', title); });

  document.querySelectorAll('.tabs button').forEach((b) => {
    b.setAttribute('aria-label', b.textContent.trim());
    b.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.tabs button').forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-selected', x === b ? 'true' : 'false'));
    });
  });
  const active = document.querySelector('.tabs button.on');
  if (active) active.setAttribute('aria-selected','true');
})();
</script>


<style id="sunlinq-v230-mapping-coverage-css">
.mapv-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
.mapv-pill.na{background:#eef2f6;color:#435468;border:1px solid #b4bec8}
.mapv-card.mapv-card-na{box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 #718096}
.mapv-current.na{border-left:3px solid #718096}
@media(max-width:1100px){.mapv-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important}}
.mapv-coverage{margin:-2px 0 10px;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;background:var(--panel2)}
.mapv-cover-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:11px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px}
.mapv-cover-head strong{color:var(--navy-2)}
.mapv-cover-track{height:9px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--line) 80%,transparent);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
.mapv-cover-fill{height:100%;background:#0d9488;transition:width .2s ease}
.mapv-cover-note{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}
.mapv-kpis button.mapv-stat{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--panel2);color:inherit;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 8px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.mapv-kpis button.mapv-stat:hover,.mapv-kpis button.mapv-stat:focus-visible{border-color:var(--accent);outline:2px solid transparent}
.mapv-kpis button.mapv-stat.active{box-shadow:inset 3px 0 var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.mapv-kpis button.mapv-stat b{font-size:18px;line-height:1.1;color:var(--navy-2)}
.mapv-kpis button.mapv-stat span{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.3}
.mapv-kpis button.mapv-stat[data-mapv-stat="unmapped"] b{color:#b45309}
.mapv-kpis button.mapv-stat[data-mapv-stat="review"] b{color:#b45309}
.mapv-actions{margin:4px 0 9px;gap:5px}
.mapv-actions .btn{font-size:10.5px;padding:6px 8px}
.mapv-current{margin:2px 0 10px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5}
.mapv-current b{display:block;font-size:12px;margin-top:2px;color:var(--navy-2)}
.mapv-current .mapv-flag{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px;font-weight:700}
.mapv-current.mapped{border-left:3px solid #0d9488}.mapv-current.unmapped{border-left:3px solid #d97706}
.mapv-map-note{font-size:10px;margin-top:3px;color:var(--muted)}
.mapv-card.mapv-card-unmapped{box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 #d97706}
@media(max-width:900px){.mapv-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}}
</style>
<script id="sunlinq-v222-mapping-js">
(()=>{
  const RULE_KEY='sunlinq.mappingRules.v1', AUTO_KEY='sunlinq.mappingAuto.v1';
  const S={q:'',status:'',selected:null,rules:[],lastSig:''};
  const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
  const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  function loadRules(){try{S.rules=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(RULE_KEY)||'[]')||[]}catch(e){S.rules=[]}}
  function saveRules(){localStorage.setItem(RULE_KEY,JSON.stringify(S.rules));}
  function norm(s){return String(s||'').toLowerCase().replace(/\b\d{6,}\b/g,' ').replace(/[0-9]+(?:x[0-9]+){1,3}/g,' ').replace(/[_:\-\/]+/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()}
  const DETECT=[
    [/bearings? elastomeric|elastomeric bearing/,'Elastomeric Bearing',98],[/taper ?plate/,'Bearing Taper Plate',96],[/keeper ?plate/,'Bearing Keeper Plate',96],[/super ?t\b/,'Super-T Girder',95],[/noise barrier/,'Noise Barrier',96],[/maintenance access safety rail|safety rail/,'Safety Railing',94],[/fauna/,'Fauna Fence',95],[/chainwire/,'Chainwire Fence',92],[/concrete gully|\bgully\b/,'Drainage Gully Pit',96],[/headwall/,'Headwall',95],[/\brcp\b|reinforced concrete pipe/,'Drainage Pipe (RCP)',95],[/culvert|\brcbc\b/,'Box Culvert (RCBC)',96],[/passenger seat|platform furniture/,'Platform Furniture',96],[/switchboard|switchgear/,'Electrical Switchboard',95],[/transformer/,'Transformer',95],[/underground.*tank|tank underground/,'Underground Tank',94],[/\brafter\b/,'Rafter',94],[/\bdoor\b/,'Door',90],[/\bwindow\b/,'Window',90],[/\bgutter\b/,'Gutter',92]
  ];
  function detect(r){let t=norm([r.basisValue,r.type,r.name,r.cls].join(' '));for(let [rx,n,c] of DETECT)if(rx.test(t))return{name:n,confidence:c};let cls=String(r.cls||'').replace(/^Ifc/i,'').replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g,'$1 $2');if(cls&&!/building element proxy|annotation/i.test(cls))return{name:cls,confidence:72};return{name:'Unknown asset',confidence:42}}
  function ruleMatches(rule,row){if(rule.owner&&rule.owner!==row.owner)return false;if(rule.cls&&rule.cls!==row.cls)return false;if(rule.basis&&rule.basis!==row.basis)return false;let v=norm(row.basisValue),p=norm(rule.pattern);return !!p && (rule.mode==='contains'?v.includes(p):v===p)}
  function matchedRule(row){return S.rules.find(r=>ruleMatches(r,row))||null}
  function rowStatus(row){
    // N.A. is intentionally out of owner-specific LoIN scope but still subject to project rules.
    if(row.notApplicable)return{key:'na',label:'N.A. · Project only',cls:'na'};
    // A suggested category or an approved but unapplied rule does not count as mapped.
    if(row.mapped){
      if(row.map?.slqV223Manual||row.map?.slqV222Manual)return{key:'mapped',label:'Mapped · manual',cls:'manual'};
      if(row.map?.slqAutoRuleId)return{key:'mapped',label:'Mapped · rule',cls:'auto'};
      if(row.map?.slqTaxonomyAuto)return{key:'mapped',label:'Mapped · taxonomy',cls:'auto'};
      return{key:'mapped',label:'Mapped',cls:'existing'};
    }
    if(!row.owner||row.owner==='OTHER')return{key:'owner',label:'Owner missing',cls:'unmapped'};
    if(matchedRule(row))return{key:'review',label:'Rule ready · not applied',cls:'suggested'};
    let tx=taxonomySuggestion(row),d=detect(row);
    if(tx||d.confidence>=90)return{key:'review',label:'Needs review',cls:'suggested'};
    return{key:'unmapped',label:'Unmapped',cls:'unmapped'};
  }
  function coverage(rows){
    let total=0,mapped=0,na=0,unmapped=0,review=0,ownerMissing=0;
    for(const r of rows){let n=Number(r.count)||0;total+=n;
      if(r.notApplicable)na+=n;
      else if(r.mapped)mapped+=n;else{unmapped+=n;let st=rowStatus(r);
        if(st.key==='review')review+=n;
        if(st.key==='owner')ownerMissing+=n;
      }
    }
    return{total,mapped,na,unmapped,review,ownerMissing,groups:rows.length,percent:total?(mapped+na)/total*100:0};
  }
  function setStatus(status){S.status=status;let select=$('#mapvStatus');if(select)select.value=status;render(null,false)}
  function getUnmappedIds(){return getRows().filter(r=>!r.mapped).flatMap(r=>r.ids||[])}
  function isolateUnmapped(){let ids=getUnmappedIds();if(!ids.length){window.$s?.('No unmapped objects to isolate');return}
    try{if(!window.Ln?.setVisible)throw Error('3D isolation unavailable');window.Ln.setVisible(new Set(ids));window.Ln.zoomTo?.(ids);window.$s?.(ids.length+' unmapped objects shown in 3D')}
    catch(e){window.$s?.('3D isolation unavailable in the current model or data-only mode')}
  }
  function exportUnmapped(){let rows=getRows().filter(r=>!r.mapped);if(!rows.length){window.$s?.('All mapped; no exceptions to export');return}
    const quote=v=>'"'+String(v??'').replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';
    let csv=[['Object ID','Object name / type','IFC class','Returned Works Owner','Mapping status','Detected asset','Candidate category','Candidate sub-category'].map(quote).join(',')];
    for(const r of rows){let tx=taxonomySuggestion(r),st=rowStatus(r),d=detect(r);
      for(const id of r.ids||[])csv.push([id,r.basisValue||r.name||'',r.cls,r.ownerRaw||r.owner||'',st.label,d.name,tx?.category||'',tx?.subCategory||''].map(quote).join(','));
    }
    let blob=new Blob(['\ufeff'+csv.join('\r\n')],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}),url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');
    a.href=url;a.download='SunLinQ_Unmapped_Objects.csv';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),5000);
  }
  function categories(owner){let a=(window.tt?.schema?.components||[]).filter(c=>String(c.kind||'').toUpperCase()===owner).map(c=>String(c.category||c.group||'')).filter(Boolean);return [...new Set(a)].sort()}
  function subcats(owner,cat){let a=(window.tt?.schema?.components||[]).filter(c=>String(c.kind||'').toUpperCase()===owner&&String(c.category||c.group||'')===cat).map(c=>String(c.subCategory||c.name||'')).filter(Boolean);return [...new Set(a)].sort()}
  const STOP=new Set(['asset','system','component','components','element','elements','the','and','of','for','new','existing','network']);
  function words(s){return norm(s).split(' ').filter(x=>x.length>2&&!STOP.has(x)).map(x=>x.endsWith('ies')?x.slice(0,-3)+'y':x.endsWith('s')&&x.length>4?x.slice(0,-1):x)}
  function taxonomySuggestion(row){
    if(!row?.owner||row.owner==='OTHER')return null;
    const comps=(window.tt?.schema?.components||[]).filter(c=>String(c.kind||'').toUpperCase()===row.owner);
    if(!comps.length)return null;
    const d=detect(row),asset=norm(d.name),finger=norm([row.basisValue,row.type,row.name,row.cls].join(' ')),aw=new Set(words(d.name+' '+row.basisValue));
    const uniq=new Map;
    for(const c of comps){let category=String(c.category||c.group||''),subCategory=String(c.subCategory||c.name||'');if(!category||!subCategory)continue;let k=category+'||'+subCategory;if(uniq.has(k))continue;
      let sn=norm(subCategory),cn=norm(category),sw=new Set(words(subCategory)),cw=new Set(words(category)),score=0,reasons=[];
      if(sn===asset){score=100;reasons.push('exact asset = sub-category')}
      else if(asset.length>4&&sn.includes(asset)){score=Math.max(score,96);reasons.push('sub-category contains detected asset')}
      else if(sn.length>4&&asset.includes(sn)){score=Math.max(score,94);reasons.push('detected asset contains sub-category')}
      let overlap=[...aw].filter(x=>sw.has(x));if(overlap.length){let ratio=overlap.length/Math.max(1,Math.min(aw.size,sw.size));score=Math.max(score,65+Math.round(ratio*25));reasons.push('matching terms: '+overlap.join(', '))}
      let catOverlap=[...aw].filter(x=>cw.has(x));if(catOverlap.length){score+=Math.min(8,catOverlap.length*4);reasons.push('category context: '+catOverlap.join(', '))}
      // Known semantic normalisations from the project IFC corpus. These do not assign owner; owner is already fixed above.
      if(/drainage pipe|\brcp\b/.test(asset+' '+finger)&&/pipe/.test(sn)&&/drainage/.test(cn)){score=Math.max(score,96);reasons.push('drainage pipe fingerprint')}
      if(/gully/.test(asset+' '+finger)&&/gully|inlet/.test(sn)&&/drainage/.test(cn)){score=Math.max(score,93);reasons.push('gully fingerprint')}
      if(/elastomeric bearing/.test(asset+' '+finger)&&/bearing/.test(sn)&&/bridge/.test(cn)){score=Math.max(score,96);reasons.push('bridge bearing fingerprint')}
      if(/switchboard|switchgear/.test(asset+' '+finger)&&/switchboard|junction box/.test(sn)){score=Math.max(score,95);reasons.push('switchboard fingerprint')}
      if(/fauna fence/.test(asset+' '+finger)&&/fauna|fenc/.test(sn)){score=Math.max(score,94);reasons.push('fauna fence fingerprint')}
      uniq.set(k,{owner:row.owner,category,subCategory,score:Math.min(100,score),reasons});
    }
    let arr=[...uniq.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||a.subCategory.localeCompare(b.subCategory)),best=arr[0];if(!best||best.score<55)return null;best.margin=best.score-(arr[1]?.score||0);best.auto=best.score>=92&&best.margin>=6;return best;
  }
  function upsertMapping(row,category,subCategory,meta={}){
    const schema=window.tt?.schema;if(!schema||!row||row.notApplicable||!category||!subCategory)return false;
    const comps=window.slqMapComponents(schema,row.owner,category,subCategory);if(!comps.length)return false;
    const all=(schema.mapping?.rows||[]).filter(r=>!(r.uiMapping&&r.mapKey===row.key));
    all.push({uiMapping:true,mapKey:row.key,uiOwner:row.owner,uiCategory:category,uiSubCategory:subCategory,cls:row.cls,type:row.basis==='type'?row.basisValue:'',name:'',prop:row.basis==='name'?'Attr.Name':'',value:row.basis==='name'?row.basisValue:'',components:comps.map(c=>c.id),row:all.length+2,...meta});
    schema.mapping={...(schema.mapping||{}),mode:'only',source:'Schema Mapping + V2.26 Accordion Mapping Toggle',rows:all};
    window.tt.compStats=null;if(window.Kn){Kn.cache=null;Kn.cacheFor=null}
    return true;
  }
  function applyApprovedRules(rows){if(!$('#mapvAuto')?.checked)return 0;let n=0;for(const row of rows){if(row.mapped)continue;let r=matchedRule(row);if(!r)continue;if(upsertMapping(row,r.category,r.subCategory,{slqAutoRuleId:r.id,slqV222Detected:r.commonAsset||detect(row).name,slqV222Confidence:r.confidence||99}))n++}if(n&&window.xo)window.xo(false);return n}
  function applyTaxonomyAuto(rows){if(!$('#mapvAuto')?.checked)return 0;let n=0;for(const row of rows){if(row.mapped||matchedRule(row))continue;let t=taxonomySuggestion(row);if(!t?.auto)continue;if(upsertMapping(row,t.category,t.subCategory,{slqTaxonomyAuto:true,slqV222Detected:detect(row).name,slqV222Confidence:t.score,slqTaxonomyReason:t.reasons.join('; ')}))n++}if(n&&window.xo)window.xo(false);return n}
  function getRows(){if(!window.tt?.model||!window.tt?.schema||!window.slqBuildMappingRows)return[];return window.slqBuildMappingRows(window.tt.schema)}
  function currentSelected(rows){return rows.find(r=>r.key===S.selected)||null}
  function options(vals,current,placeholder){return `<option value="">${esc(placeholder)}</option>`+vals.map(v=>`<option value="${esc(v)}" ${v===current?'selected':''}>${esc(v)}</option>`).join('')}
  function renderEditor(row){const box=$('#mapvEditor'),list=$('#mapvList');if(!box)return;if(!row){box.classList.add('hidden');return}box.classList.remove('hidden');const card=list?.querySelector(`[data-mapv-key=\"${CSS.escape(row.key)}\"]`);if(card&&box.previousElementSibling!==card)card.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',box);let d=detect(row),rule=matchedRule(row),tx=taxonomySuggestion(row);$('#mapvEditAsset').textContent=row.mapped?(row.subCategory||row.category||d.name):d.name;
    const current=$('#mapvCurrent');if(current){let status=rowStatus(row);current.className='mapv-current '+(row.notApplicable?'na':row.mapped?'mapped':'unmapped');current.innerHTML=row.notApplicable?
      `<span class="mapv-flag">N.A. — Project only</span><b>Returned Works Owner: N.A.</b><div class="mapv-map-note">No TMR or QR asset classification is required. DSCRLP – PROJECT parameters remain mandatory.</div>`:row.mapped?
      `<span class="mapv-flag">${esc(status.label)}</span><b>${esc(row.owner)} › ${esc(row.category)} › ${esc(row.subCategory)}</b><div class="mapv-map-note">Confirmed mapping, separate from automatic object detection below.</div>`:
      `<span class="mapv-flag">${esc(status.label)}</span><b>No owner taxonomy classification applied</b><div class="mapv-map-note">Select the exact Category and Sub-category from the imported LoIN, then Apply Mapping.</div>`;}
    $('#mapvEditFingerprint').textContent=`${row.basis}: ${row.basisValue||'(class only)'}`;$('#mapvDetected').textContent=d.name;$('#mapvConfidence').textContent=`${d.confidence}% (automatic detection)`;$('#mapvOwner').textContent=(row.owner||row.ownerRaw||'Not set')+(row.ownerSource?' · IFC':'');$('#mapvOwner').title=row.ownerSource?`Source: ${row.ownerSource}`:'';$('#mapvClass').textContent=row.cls||'';
    const cat=$('#mapvCategory'),sub=$('#mapvSubCategory');let cats=categories(row.owner),curCat=row.category||rule?.category||tx?.category||'',curSub=row.subCategory||rule?.subCategory||tx?.subCategory||'';cat.innerHTML=options(cats,curCat,'Select category…');sub.innerHTML=options(curCat?subcats(row.owner,curCat):[],curSub,'Select sub-category…');cat.onchange=()=>{sub.innerHTML=options(subcats(row.owner,cat.value),'','Select sub-category…')};
    let note=$('#mapvTaxNote');if(!note){note=document.createElement('div');note.id='mapvTaxNote';note.className='muted sm';note.style.margin='5px 0 2px';sub.parentElement.after(note)}
    if(row.notApplicable)note.textContent='N.A. confirmed from the IFC owner property. Asset-owner mapping is not applicable; project-wide LoIN parameters still apply.';
    else if(row.mapped)note.textContent=row.map?.slqTaxonomyAuto?`Auto-mapped from ${row.owner} taxonomy${row.map?.slqTaxonomyReason?' — '+row.map.slqTaxonomyReason:''}`:'Mapped';
    else if(tx)note.textContent=`${tx.auto?'Strong':'Possible'} ${row.owner} taxonomy match (${tx.score}%): ${tx.category} › ${tx.subCategory}`;
    else if(row.owner&&row.owner!=='OTHER')note.textContent=`${row.owner} owner confirmed, but no defensible Category/Sub-category match was found in the imported LoIN matrix. Review manually and optionally save a rule.`;
    else note.textContent='Return Works Owner is missing.';
    cat.disabled=!!row.notApplicable;sub.disabled=!!row.notApplicable;
    $('#mapvApply').disabled=!!row.notApplicable;
    $('#mapvReset').disabled=!!row.notApplicable;
    $$('#mapvEditor input[name="mapvScope"], #mapvSaveRule').forEach(el=>el.disabled=!!row.notApplicable);
  }
  function selectRow(key,focus=false,forceOpen=false){
    // Accordion behavior: clicking the currently open asset closes its editor.
    // Review Mapping uses forceOpen=true so it always opens the target asset.
    if(!forceOpen && S.selected===key){
      S.selected=null;
      render(null,false);
      const editor=$('#mapvEditor');
      if(editor)editor.classList.add('hidden');
      return;
    }
    S.selected=key;
    let rows=getRows(),row=currentSelected(rows);
    render(rows,false);
    renderEditor(row);
    if(row?.ids?.length&&window.nL){try{window.nL(row.ids[0]);if(window.Ln?.zoomTo)window.Ln.zoomTo([row.ids[0]])}catch(e){}}
    if(focus){
      requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
        const card=$('#mapvList')?.querySelector(`[data-mapv-key=\"${CSS.escape(key)}\"]`),editor=$('#mapvEditor');
        const target=editor&&!editor.classList.contains('hidden')?editor:card;
        if(target){target.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});target.classList.add('mapv-review-focus');setTimeout(()=>target.classList.remove('mapv-review-focus'),1400)}
      });
    }
  }
  function reviewMapping(key){
    // A suggestion can refer to a row hidden by the current search/status filter.
    // Clear those filters so its asset card and inline editor are guaranteed visible.
    S.q='';S.status='';
    const q=$('#mapvSearch'),st=$('#mapvStatus');if(q)q.value='';if(st)st.value='';
    selectRow(key,true,true);
  }
  function renderRules(){let box=$('#mapvRules'),count=$('#mapvRuleCount');if(!box)return;count.textContent=`${S.rules.length} rule${S.rules.length===1?'':'s'}`;box.innerHTML=S.rules.length?S.rules.map(r=>`<div class="mapv-rule"><div class="r1">${esc(r.commonAsset||'Mapping rule')}</div><div class="r2">${esc(r.cls)} · ${esc(r.pattern)} → ${esc(r.owner)} / ${esc(r.category)} / ${esc(r.subCategory)}</div><button class="btn sm del" data-mapv-del="${esc(r.id)}">Delete</button></div>`).join(''):'<div class="muted sm" style="padding:8px 0">No approved rules yet. Save a user correction as a rule to start the knowledge base.</div>';$$('[data-mapv-del]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{S.rules=S.rules.filter(r=>r.id!==b.dataset.mapvDel);saveRules();render()})}
  function renderSuggestions(rows){let box=$('#mapvSuggestions');if(!box)return;let sug=rows.filter(r=>!r.mapped&&!matchedRule(r)).map(r=>({r,d:detect(r),tx:taxonomySuggestion(r)})).filter(x=>x.tx||x.d.confidence>=90).sort((a,b)=>(b.tx?.score||b.d.confidence)-(a.tx?.score||a.d.confidence)||b.r.count-a.r.count).slice(0,5);box.innerHTML=sug.length?sug.map(x=>`<div class="mapv-suggestion"><div class="s1"><b>${x.tx?'Taxonomy suggestion':'New fingerprint'} · ${esc(x.d.name)}</b><span class="mapv-conf">${x.tx?.score||x.d.confidence}%</span></div><div class="s2">${x.tx?esc(`${x.tx.owner} › ${x.tx.category} › ${x.tx.subCategory}`):esc(`${x.r.cls} · ${x.r.basisValue||'class only'}`)} · ${x.r.count} object${x.r.count===1?'':'s'}</div><button class="btn sm" data-mapv-review="${esc(x.r.key)}">Review mapping</button></div>`).join(''):'<div class="muted sm" style="padding-top:7px">No taxonomy or high-confidence fingerprint suggestions waiting for review.</div>';$$('[data-mapv-review]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();reviewMapping(b.dataset.mapvReview)})}
  function render(rowsArg,auto=true){
    let rows=rowsArg||getRows(),empty=$('#mapvEmpty'),body=$('#mapvBody');if(!empty||!body)return;
    if(!window.tt?.model){empty.hidden=false;body.hidden=true;return}
    empty.hidden=true;body.hidden=false;
    if(auto){let n1=applyApprovedRules(rows);if(n1)rows=getRows();let n2=applyTaxonomyAuto(rows);if(n2)rows=getRows()}
    let q=(S.q||'').trim().toLowerCase();
    let filtered=rows.filter(r=>{
      let d=detect(r),st=rowStatus(r);
      if(q&&!([d.name,r.owner,r.ownerRaw,r.cls,r.basisValue,r.category,r.subCategory].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q)))return false;
      if(S.status==='unmapped')return !r.mapped&&!r.notApplicable; // includes review and missing owner
      if(S.status==='owner')return !r.mapped&&st.key==='owner';
      if(S.status&&st.key!==S.status)return false;
      return true;
    });
    const c=coverage(rows),pct=c.percent.toFixed(1);
    $('#mapvKpis').innerHTML=`<button class="mapv-stat ${S.status===''?'active':''}" data-mapv-stat=""><b>${c.total.toLocaleString()}</b><span>Total objects · ${c.groups} logical groups</span></button>`+
      `<button class="mapv-stat ${S.status==='mapped'?'active':''}" data-mapv-stat="mapped"><b>${c.mapped.toLocaleString()}</b><span>Mapped to owner taxonomy</span></button>`+
      `<button class="mapv-stat ${S.status==='na'?'active':''}" data-mapv-stat="na"><b>${c.na.toLocaleString()}</b><span>N.A. · Project only</span></button>`+
      `<button class="mapv-stat ${S.status==='unmapped'?'active':''}" data-mapv-stat="unmapped"><b>${c.unmapped.toLocaleString()}</b><span>Unmapped (incl. review)</span></button>`+
      `<button class="mapv-stat ${S.status==='review'?'active':''}" data-mapv-stat="review"><b>${c.review.toLocaleString()}</b><span>Needs review (subset)</span></button>`;
    $$('[data-mapv-stat]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>setStatus(b.dataset.mapvStat));
    $('#mapvCoverage').innerHTML=`<div class="mapv-cover-head"><strong>Classification resolved: ${pct}%</strong><span>${c.mapped.toLocaleString()} mapped + ${c.na.toLocaleString()} N.A. / ${c.total.toLocaleString()} objects</span></div>`+
      `<div class="mapv-cover-track"><div class="mapv-cover-fill" style="width:${c.percent}%"></div></div>`+
      `<div class="mapv-cover-note">${c.unmapped?`${c.unmapped.toLocaleString()} object(s) require mapping, including ${c.ownerMissing.toLocaleString()} with missing owner.`:'No owner classifications outstanding.'} N.A. objects require DSCRLP – PROJECT checks only. Suggestions are not mapped until applied.</div>`;
    const filterButton=$('#mapvUnmappedOnly');filterButton.textContent=S.status==='unmapped'?'Show all objects':'Show unmapped only';
    const isolator=$('#mapvIsolateUnmapped');isolator.disabled=c.unmapped===0;
    const exporter=$('#mapvExportUnmapped');exporter.disabled=c.unmapped===0;
    const __mapvList=$('#mapvList'),__mapvEditor=$('#mapvEditor');
    if(__mapvEditor&&__mapvEditor.parentElement===__mapvList)__mapvList.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',__mapvEditor);
    __mapvList.innerHTML=filtered.length?filtered.slice(0,500).map(r=>{
      let d=detect(r),rr=matchedRule(r),st=rowStatus(r),tx=taxonomySuggestion(r);
      let conf=tx?.score||d.confidence;
      let path=r.notApplicable?'N.A. · Owner-specific mapping not applicable · DSCRLP – PROJECT mandatory':r.mapped?`${r.owner} › ${r.category} › ${r.subCategory}`:
        rr?`Rule available, not applied: ${rr.owner} › ${rr.category} › ${rr.subCategory}`:
        tx?`Suggested, not applied: ${tx.owner} › ${tx.category} › ${tx.subCategory}`:
        (r.owner&&r.owner!=='OTHER'?`${r.owner} owner confirmed · no mapped asset category`:'Return Works Owner missing');
      // The mapped classification is the card title, not the uncertain automatic detector label.
      let displayName=r.notApplicable?(r.basisValue||r.name||r.type||r.cls||'N.A. object'):r.mapped?(r.subCategory||r.category||d.name):d.name;
      return `<div class="mapv-card ${S.selected===r.key?'sel':''} ${r.notApplicable?'mapv-card-na':r.mapped?'':'mapv-card-unmapped'}" data-mapv-key="${esc(r.key)}">`+
        `<div class="mapv-row1"><span class="mapv-asset">${esc(displayName)}</span><span class="mapv-count">${r.count.toLocaleString()} obj</span><span class="mapv-pill ${st.cls}">${esc(st.label)}</span></div>`+
        `<div class="mapv-row2"><span class="mapv-pill owner">${esc((r.notApplicable?'N.A.':(r.owner||r.ownerRaw||'No owner'))+(r.ownerSource?' · IFC':''))}</span>`+
        `<span class="mapv-ifc">${esc(r.cls)} · ${esc(r.basisValue||'class only')}</span>`+
        `${r.mapped?'':`<span class="mapv-conf ${conf<70?'low':''}" title="Automatic detection/suggestion, not mapping approval">${conf}% suggestion</span>`}</div>`+
        `<div class="mapv-path">${esc(path)}</div></div>`;
    }).join(''):'<div class="mapv-noresults">No mapping groups match this filter.</div>';
    $$('[data-mapv-key]').forEach(c=>c.onclick=()=>selectRow(c.dataset.mapvKey));
    renderSuggestions(rows);renderRules();renderEditor(currentSelected(filtered));
  }
  function applySelection(){let rows=getRows(),row=currentSelected(rows);if(!row||row.notApplicable)return;let cat=$('#mapvCategory').value,sub=$('#mapvSubCategory').value;if(!cat||!sub){window.$s?window.$s('Select Category and Sub-category first'):alert('Select Category and Sub-category first');return}let scope=$('input[name="mapvScope"]:checked')?.value||'fingerprint',targets=scope==='similar'?rows.filter(r=>r.owner===row.owner&&r.cls===row.cls&&detect(r).name===detect(row).name):[row],changed=0;for(let t of targets)if(upsertMapping(t,cat,sub,{slqV223Manual:true,slqV222Detected:detect(t).name,slqV222Confidence:99,slqOwnerSource:t.ownerSource||''}))changed+=t.count;
    if($('#mapvSaveRule').checked){let id='MAP-'+String(Date.now()).slice(-8),r={id,owner:row.owner,cls:row.cls,basis:row.basis,pattern:norm(row.basisValue),mode:'exact',commonAsset:detect(row).name,category:cat,subCategory:sub,confidence:99,createdAt:new Date().toISOString()};S.rules.unshift(r);saveRules()}
    if(window.xo)window.xo(false);window.$s&&window.$s(`Mapping applied to ${changed.toLocaleString()} object${changed===1?'':'s'}${$('#mapvSaveRule').checked?' and rule saved':''}`);setTimeout(()=>render(),50)
  }
  function resetSelection(){let row=currentSelected(getRows());if(!row)return;if(window.slqClearUiMapping)window.slqClearUiMapping(row);setTimeout(()=>render(),50)}
  function boot(){loadRules();let auto=localStorage.getItem(AUTO_KEY);if(auto!==null)$('#mapvAuto').checked=auto==='1';$('#mapvSearch').oninput=e=>{S.q=e.target.value;render(null,false)};$('#mapvStatus').onchange=e=>{S.status=e.target.value;render(null,false)};
    $('#mapvUnmappedOnly').onclick=()=>setStatus(S.status==='unmapped'?'':'unmapped');
    $('#mapvIsolateUnmapped').onclick=isolateUnmapped;
    $('#mapvShowAllObjects').onclick=()=>{try{window.Ln?.setVisible(null);window.Ln?.fitAll?.()}catch(e){window.$s?.('3D viewer unavailable')}};
    $('#mapvExportUnmapped').onclick=exportUnmapped;
    $('#mapvAuto').onchange=e=>{localStorage.setItem(AUTO_KEY,e.target.checked?'1':'0');render()};$('#mapvOpenSchema').onclick=()=>window.Eme?window.Eme('mapping'):$('#btnSchemaView')?.click();$('#mapvEditClose').onclick=()=>{S.selected=null;$('#mapvEditor').classList.add('hidden');render(null,false)};$('#mapvApply').onclick=applySelection;$('#mapvReset').onclick=resetSelection;
    let btn=document.querySelector('.tabs button[data-tab="mapping"]');if(btn)btn.addEventListener('click',()=>setTimeout(()=>render(),0));
    setInterval(()=>{let active=document.querySelector('.tabs button[data-tab="mapping"]')?.classList.contains('on');if(!active)return;let sig=[window.tt?.fileName||'',window.tt?.model?.elements?.size||0,window.tt?.schema?.components?.length||0,window.tt?.schema?.mapping?.rows?.length||0,S.rules.length].join('|');if(sig!==S.lastSig){S.lastSig=sig;render()}},1200);
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',boot);else boot();
})();
</script>
<script id="slq-stage-gate-pset-controls">
(()=>{
  'use strict';
  const KEY='ownerPsetGateOverrides';
  const REASONS='ownerPsetGateReasons';
  const state=()=>window.__irc?.state;
  const standardOwner=o=>{const v=String(o||'').trim().toUpperCase();return v==='QR'?'QRL':v};
  const clean=s=>String(s||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
  const norm=s=>clean(s).replace(/[\s_-]+/g,' ').toUpperCase();
  function identify(rule){
    const owner=standardOwner(rule?.owner);
    if(owner!=='TMR'&&owner!=='QRL')return null;
    const raw=String(rule?.prop||'').split('|')[0].trim();
    const pos=raw.indexOf('.');
    if(pos<1)return null;
    const pset=clean(raw.slice(0,pos));
    // Owner Pset opt-outs can never suppress common DSCRLP project checks.
    if(!pset||pset==='*'||/^Attr$/i.test(pset)||/^DSCRLP[ _-]*PROJECT/i.test(pset))return null;
    return {owner,pset,key:owner+'::'+norm(pset)};
  }
  function stageItems(schema,gate){
    // Always list every TMR and QR Pset defined in the imported project LoIN,
    // including property sets not scheduled for the currently selected gate.
    // No fabricated Pset names or requirements.
    const all=new Map();
    for(const r of schema?.rules||[]){
      const v=identify(r);if(!v)continue;
      if(!all.has(v.key))all.set(v.key,{...v,required:0,placeholder:0});
      const mark=r.stages? r.stages[gate] : 'R';
      if(mark==='P')all.get(v.key).placeholder++;
      else if(mark==='R')all.get(v.key).required++;
    }
    const saved=schema?.settings?.[KEY]?.[gate]||{};
    return [...all.values()].map(x=>({
      ...x,applicable:(x.required+x.placeholder)>0,
      enabled:saved[x.key]!==false
    })).sort((a,b)=>a.owner.localeCompare(b.owner)||a.pset.localeCompare(b.pset));
  }
  function isExcluded(rule,gate,schema){
    const v=identify(rule);
    const mark=rule?.stages?rule.stages[gate]:'R';
    return !!(v&&(mark==='R'||mark==='P')&&schema?.settings?.[KEY]?.[gate]?.[v.key]===false);
  }
  // Used directly by the application validator. A rule's required stage and
  // source matrix markers are retained untouched for future submissions.
  window.slqGateExcluded=isExcluded;
  const htmlEscape=value=>String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  const currentGate=()=>document.getElementById('stageSel')?.value||state()?.schema?.settings?.stage||'';
  function render(){
    const root=document.getElementById('slqStageScope'),app=state();
    if(!root||!app)return;
    const schema=app.schema,gate=currentGate();
    if(!schema||!gate){root.hidden=true;return;}
    const items=stageItems(schema,gate);
    if(!items.length){root.hidden=true;root.innerHTML='';return;}
    root.hidden=false;
    const counts={TMR:items.filter(x=>x.owner==='TMR'),QRL:items.filter(x=>x.owner==='QRL')};
    const nDeferred=items.filter(x=>x.applicable&&!x.enabled).length;
    const nDue=items.filter(x=>x.applicable).length;
    const nNotDue=items.length-nDue;
    const reasons=schema.settings?.[REASONS]||{};
    root.innerHTML='<div class="slq-scope-head">TMR / QR property set delivery <span style="font-size:11px;opacity:.72">'+htmlEscape(gate)+'</span></div>'+
      '<div class="slq-scope-sub">All imported TMR and QR property sets are shown. Tick or untick those scheduled at the selected stage. Greyed-out sets are not due at this gate. Unchecked = deferred, not passed. Original LoIN unchanged.</div>'+
      ['TMR','QRL'].map(owner=>!counts[owner].length?'':'<div class="slq-scope-owner">'+(owner==='QRL'?'QR':owner)+'</div><div class="slq-scope-grid">'+counts[owner].map(item=>
        '<label class="slq-scope-option '+(!item.applicable?'notdue':item.enabled?'':'deferred')+'"><input type="checkbox" data-scope-key="'+encodeURIComponent(item.key)+'" '+(item.applicable&&item.enabled?'checked':'')+' '+(item.applicable?'':'disabled')+'><span><b>'+htmlEscape(item.pset)+'</b><small style="display:block;opacity:.72">'+(item.applicable?(item.required+' required · '+item.placeholder+' placeholder'):'Not scheduled at '+htmlEscape(gate))+'</small></span></label>').join('')+'</div>').join('')+
      '<div class="slq-scope-meta">'+items.length+' source Psets: '+(nDue-nDeferred)+' checked / '+nDeferred+' deferred / '+nNotDue+' not yet scheduled at '+htmlEscape(gate)+'. DSCRLP – PROJECT requirements remain compulsory.</div>'+
      (nDeferred?'<div class="slq-scope-note"><label for="slq-scope-reason">Reason for deferral (recorded in MVC)</label><textarea id="slq-scope-reason" placeholder="e.g. asset owner information not established for this stage">'+htmlEscape(reasons[gate]||'')+'</textarea></div>':'')+
      '<div class="slq-scope-actions"><span class="slq-scope-warn">A deferred property set is excluded from the compliance percentage; formal approval is separate.</span><button type="button" id="slq-scope-reset">Enable all</button></div>';
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-scope-key]').forEach(box=>{
      box.onchange=()=>{
        const key=decodeURIComponent(box.dataset.scopeKey);
        const current=schema.settings?.[KEY]||{};
        const forGate={...(current[gate]||{}),[key]:box.checked};
        schema.settings={...(schema.settings||{}),[KEY]:{...current,[gate]:forGate}};
        if(typeof window.xo==='function')window.xo(false);
        render();
      };
    });
    const reason=root.querySelector('#slq-scope-reason');
    if(reason)reason.oninput=()=>{
      const prev=schema.settings?.[REASONS]||{};
      schema.settings={...(schema.settings||{}),[REASONS]:{...prev,[gate]:reason.value}};
      if(typeof window.xo==='function')window.xo(false);
    };
    root.querySelector('#slq-scope-reset').onclick=()=>{
      const current=schema.settings?.[KEY]||{};
      const forGate={...(current[gate]||{})};
      for(const item of items)if(item.applicable)delete forGate[item.key];
      schema.settings={...(schema.settings||{}),[KEY]:{...current,[gate]:forGate}};
      if(typeof window.xo==='function')window.xo(false);
      render();
    };
  }
  window.slqPsetScope={render,listForStage:stageItems,isExcluded};
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',render);else render();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
